days.title: Days
days.description: How many days of history this covers, counting today.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One or two sentences with the numbers: days at or above the threshold, minutes, the highest reading, the last 24 hours and the newest reading. Use it as written in an escalation reason.

dailyLines.title: Daily Lines
dailyLines.description: One line per day that had readings at or above the threshold, newest first.

daysWithAlerts.title: Days With Alerts
daysWithAlerts.description: Days in the period with at least one reading at or above the threshold.

minutesAtOrAbove.title: Minutes At Or Above Threshold
minutesAtOrAbove.description: About how many minutes in the period the device read at or above the threshold.

highestTemperature.title: Highest Temperature
highestTemperature.description: The highest reading in C on those days.

last24hReadings.title: Last 24 Hours Readings
last24hReadings.description: How many readings Data Cloud holds for the last 24 hours.

last24hMinutesAtOrAbove.title: Last 24 Hours Minutes At Or Above Threshold
last24hMinutesAtOrAbove.description: About how many of the last 24 hours, in minutes, the device read at or above the threshold.

last24hHighest.title: Last 24 Hours Highest Temperature
last24hHighest.description: The highest reading in C in the last 24 hours.

lastReadingAt.title: Last Reading At
lastReadingAt.description: The newest reading Data Cloud holds for the device.

lastReadingAgeMinutes.title: Last Reading Age Minutes
lastReadingAgeMinutes.description: How many minutes ago that newest reading was taken.

thresholdCelsius.title: Threshold Celsius
thresholdCelsius.description: The temperature alert threshold the history is counted against.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: How fresh the history is, and what a missing day means.
